objective: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

description: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance.  Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.
Do not let this happen, <name>!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
